### Added
- **Preset `qwen3-8-27b-l40s`: Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4 on one 48 GB GPU** (giantswarm/agent-platform#544). The shipped `qwen3-8-27b` is tuned for a 128 GB unified-memory Blackwell node and hosts on no size of the curated AWS accelerator families (giantswarm/agent-platform#535). The new preset serves the same Inferact NVFP4 repack on one L40S — `g6e.2xlarge` or `g6e.4xlarge` — with the flags a live probe proved: `--gpu-memory-utilization=0.92`, `--max-model-len=65536`, `--max-num-seqs=4`, `--max-num-batched-tokens=8192`, chunked prefill, prefix caching, one image per prompt, the `qwen3` reasoning parser, tools on with the `qwen3_coder` parser, thinking off by default, no speculative decoding, no `CUTE_DSL_ARCH`, the model's own chat template; requests 4 vCPU / 32 GiB, limits 8 / 48 GiB; `weightsGiB: 25` (the Hub's size), `overheadGiB: 16`; `predictor.timeout: 1800`. Ada has no native FP4: vLLM takes the Marlin weight-only FP4 path, loads 24.17 GiB of weights and keeps 14.65 GiB for the KV cache (222,822 tokens, 3.4 concurrent 64k requests). cluster-manager's `presetFit` hosts it on `2xlarge` and up of the L40S family (`g6e.xlarge` leaves a predictor 3 vCPU / 27.1 GiB) and on no L4, A10G or T4 size (25 + 16 = 41 GiB > 24). `make verify-wiring` expects ten shipped presets; `verify-preset-weights` and the eval check of `verify-serving-slice` cover the new file.
